title: ProgressIndicator
summary: The indeterminate linear bar now slides: a 30%-wide bar travels across the track in 1.5s on an ease-in-out curve, instead of a stationary 30% bar that pulsed (which read as "30% done"). With reduced motion it holds a static 30% fill with no movement. Percentage labels use tabular figures so digits do not jitter while the value counts up.
apiNote: No prop, aria or DOM-contract change for the determinate bar: role=progressbar, aria-valuemin/max/now and aria-label are as before; the indeterminate bar still omits aria-valuenow and still has the track > fill structure (30% width inline style). The indeterminate bar additionally contains a <style> element with the keyframes (after the fill, display:none), the same self-contained approach BouncingLoader uses; no theme change and no tailwindcss-animate needed.
why: The previous indeterminate bar was a fixed 30% fill with an opacity pulse, which users can read as a real 30% value. A bar travelling across the track says "working, unknown duration" without implying a value; this is the pattern named in the brief's research.
Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) are standard for live numeric labels so the label width and neighbouring layout stay steady as digits change.
Reduced motion removes the spatial movement (design/V2-MOTION.md); the static partial fill is what the old reduced-motion state already showed.
Research references (HeroUI, Mantine, shadcn/ui, Untitled UI, React Aria) come from the task brief's research conclusions; they were not re-verified source by source while implementing.

scenarioLabels.bar-indeterminate-start: Indeterminate at t = 0 (before: pulsing static bar)

motion.after: 30% bar translates from -100% to 350% of its own width, 1.5s, cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), infinite; clipped by the track. Reduced motion: no animation, static 30% fill at the left.

motion.before: Spinning ring (1s linear; 2s under reduced motion)

states: ProgressIndicator / Bar / Indeterminate: a new animated prototype (frame 1 and frame 2 below); the static design frame stays 30% fill at the left
ProgressIndicator / Bar / Percentage label, Circle / label, Semi circle / label: Inter with tabular numbers
figmaSteps: Bar track and fill geometry are unchanged: track 8px high, radius 8, fill #E9EAEB (semantic-border-layout) with a 0.2px #E9EAEB stroke, fill bar #4275D6 (semantic-info-primary), radius 8. Clip content on the track so a bar leaving the track is cut off.

Indeterminate bar: fill width = 30% of the track (95.39px in the 320px track). Frame A (start): bar X = -100% of its own width (-95px, fully outside the left edge). Frame B (end): bar X = +350% of its own width (+334px for a 320px track, fully outside the right edge). Distance travelled = 4.5 bar widths.

Prototype: After delay, Smart animate A -> B, duration 1500ms, custom cubic-bezier 0.65, 0, 0.35, 1 (ease in-out cubic), then loop B -> A with no animation (instant) to restart. Do not show the label in this state (it was never shown for indeterminate).
Reduced-motion note for the design spec: static state is the bar at X 0 (30% fill from the left), no movement, no pulse.

Percentage text (bar right/bottom label, circle label, semi circle label): turn on Inter OpenType feature Tabular numbers (tnum) on the text layer. Sizes are unchanged: bar label 12/15 regular, circle and semi circle labels 12/16 weight 500, letter spacing 0.06px. Label width grows by about 0.5px (for example "30%" 26.78 -> 27.36), no other layout change.
Remove the old Pulse prototype (opacity 100% <-> 98% loop) from the indeterminate frame.
notes: The keyframes live in a <style> child of the track, not in index.css or the consumer theme (outside this task's file scope). Consequence: a strict Content-Security-Policy without style-src 'unsafe-inline' would block the animation (the bar then shows the static 30% fill); BouncingLoader and ShimmeringText already rely on the same technique.

Alternative considered: tailwindcss-animate's `enter` keyframe with an implicit end frame. Rejected: the component would newly depend on the plugin (packages/cli/components.yaml needs a v2-progress-indicator change) and consumers without it would see an invisible bar parked off the track.

Verified with an emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce in headless Chrome: no running animation, transform none, fill width 95.39px; with no preference the transform advances between samples (-70px then 119px).
The circular indeterminate spinner is unchanged; semi-circle has no indeterminate mode.

Tabular figures widen the label slightly because digits become equal width (Inter's 1 is wider in tnum): "30%" 26.78 -> 27.36px, "100%" 31.83 -> 35.14px at 12px. The track is flex-1, so it narrows by the same amount; nothing else moves. Set the Figma text layers to Tabular numbers and let auto layout hug them.
Research references (HeroUI, Mantine, shadcn/ui, Untitled UI, React Aria) come from the task brief's research conclusions; they were not re-verified source by source while implementing.
